capabilities: write journal entries with dialog, chat, dream, and media content blocks
create new entries at the right location via commands and hotkeys
toggle entries between open and closed
show the number of open entries in the status bar
clean up the sidebar and color-code entries in a dedicated journal vault
extras: Full syntax documentation is hosted externally ("Learn more here", "check out Yesterday"); the README only shows an example whose code block content is not inline.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown has no built-in way to render chat conversations, dialogs, or structured diary blocks inside journal notes.

relations.evidence: Reader Mode ensures that notes are opened in reader mode, so you can see dialogs rendered
Note ID Organizes notes by an ID property, providing a structured way to create and maintain a note sequence

summary: Markdown syntax extension and journal toolkit for writing diary entries with dialog, chat-log, dream, and media content blocks.
